143:    def pyfloat(
144:        self,
145:        left_digits: Optional[int] = None,
146:        right_digits: Optional[int] = None,
147:        positive: Optional[bool] = None,
148:        min_value: Optional[Union[float, int]] = None,
149:        max_value: Optional[Union[float, int]] = None,
150:    ) -> float:
151:        if left_digits is not None and left_digits < 0:
152:            raise ValueError("A float number cannot have less than 0 digits in its integer part")
153:        if right_digits is not None and right_digits < 0:
154:            raise ValueError("A float number cannot have less than 0 digits in its fractional part")
155:        if left_digits == 0 and right_digits == 0:
156:            raise ValueError("A float number cannot have less than 0 digits in total")
157:        if min_value is not None and max_value is not None:
158:            if min_value > max_value:
159:                raise ValueError("Min value cannot be greater than max value")
160:        if None not in (min_value, max_value) and min_value == max_value:
161:            raise ValueError("Min and max value cannot be the same")
162:        if positive and min_value is not None and min_value <= 0:
163:            raise ValueError("Cannot combine positive=True with negative or zero min_value")
164:        if left_digits is not None and max_value and math.ceil(math.log10(abs(max_value))) > left_digits:
165:            raise ValueError("Max value must fit within left digits")
166:        if left_digits is not None and min_value and math.ceil(math.log10(abs(min_value))) > left_digits:
167:            raise ValueError("Min value must fit within left digits")
168:
169:        # Make sure at least either left or right is set
170:        if left_digits is None and right_digits is None:
171:            needed_left_digits = max(1, math.ceil(math.log10(max(abs(max_value or 1), abs(min_value or 1)))))
172:            right_digits = self.random_int(1, sys.float_info.dig - needed_left_digits)
173:
174:        # If only one side is set, choose #digits for other side
175:        if (left_digits is None) ^ (right_digits is None):
176:            if left_digits is None:
177:                left_digits = max(1, sys.float_info.dig - right_digits)
178:            else:
179:                right_digits = max(1, sys.float_info.dig - left_digits)
180:
181:        # Make sure we don't ask for too many digits!
182:        if left_digits + right_digits > sys.float_info.dig:
183:            raise ValueError(
184:                f"Asking for too many digits ({left_digits} + {right_digits} == {left_digits + right_digits} > "
185:                f"{sys.float_info.dig})",
186:            )
187:
188:        sign = ""
189:        if (min_value is not None) or (max_value is not None):
190:            # Copy values to ensure we're not modifying the original values and thus going out of bounds
191:            left_min_value = min_value
192:            left_max_value = max_value
193:            # Make sure left_digits still respected
194:            if left_digits is not None:
195:                if max_value is None:
196:                    left_max_value = 10**left_digits  # minus smallest representable, adjusted later
197:                if min_value is None:
198:                    left_min_value = -(10**left_digits)  # plus smallest representable, adjusted later
199:
200:            if max_value is not None and max_value < 0:
201:                left_max_value += 1  # as the random_int will be generated up to max_value - 1
202:            if min_value is not None and min_value < 0:
203:                left_min_value += 1  # as we then append digits after the left_number
204:            left_number = self._safe_random_int(
205:                left_min_value,
206:                left_max_value,
207:                positive,
208:            )
209:        else:
210:            if positive is None:
211:                sign = self.random_element(("+", "-"))
212:            elif positive is True:
213:                sign = "+"
214:            else:
215:                sign = "-"
216:
217:            left_number = self.random_number(left_digits)
218:
219:        result = float(f"{sign}{left_number}.{self.random_number(right_digits)}")
220:        if positive and result == 0:
221:            if right_digits:
222:                result = float("0." + "0" * (right_digits - 1) + "1")
223:            else:
224:                result += sys.float_info.epsilon
225:
226:        if right_digits:
227:            result = min(result, 10**left_digits - float(f'0.{"0" * (right_digits - 1)}1'))
228:            result = max(result, -(10**left_digits + float(f'0.{"0" * (right_digits - 1)}1')))
229:        else:
230:            result = min(result, 10**left_digits - 1)
231:            result = max(result, -(10**left_digits + 1))
232:
233:        # It's possible for the result to end up > than max_value or < than min_value
234:        # When this happens we introduce some variance so we're not always the exactly the min_value or max_value.
235:        # Which can happen a lot depending on the difference of the values.
236:        # Ensure the variance is bound by the difference between the max and min
237:        if max_value is not None:
238:            if result > max_value:
239:                result = result - (result - max_value + self.generator.random.uniform(0, max_value - min_value))
240:        if min_value is not None:
241:            if result < min_value:
242:                result = result + (min_value - result + self.generator.random.uniform(0, max_value - min_value))
243:
244:        return result
